name: Apple Alley Bakery
notes: julianapplealley.com itself now 404s on both HTTP and HTTPS (the router's TLS failure is real, and plain HTTP resolves but to the host's genuine 404 page). Found via a Wayback snapshot of the homepage (web.archive.org/web/20251011153730), whose menu link points at this wsimg.com CDN-hosted PDF - the CDN asset is still live (direct HTTP 200, not a wayback replay) and the filename says 2025. Clean two-column pdftotext -layout paired every name to a price with no ambiguity except two drops: 'Vegetarian Sandwich' is listed with no price of its own (grouped under the Half/Whole Sandwiches header but not confirmed to share that price, so omitted rather than assumed), and 'Root Beer Float' extracted as bare '550' with no decimal point (vs. its neighbor 'Chocolate Coffee Float' at 5.50) - dropped rather than assumed to be $5.50. Pie has two unlabeled prices (23.95 and 24.95), filed as two separate rows since the menu does not name which size is which.

blocked: own site (locations.bonchon.com) 404s and the real ordering platform, order.bonchon.com/menu/ca-san-diego-convoy-st-2, is a pure client-rendered Olo/Next.js shell with no server-embedded catalog - needs-browser. name: Phở Ca Dao & Grill
notes: No website was on file; found the chain site thephocadaogrill.com and its per-branch ordering subdomain escondido.thephocadaogrill.com, which is Menufy-powered (location_menufy_id 48382). Confirmed the branch via the Menufy location API - address1 "609 North Escondido Boulevard", city Escondido, state CA, matching the work list exactly (the chain-wide id 42571 found on the homepage/locations page resolves to an unrelated Overland Park, KS portal record and was NOT used). 111 priced items read from the categories/all API. Prices are clean whole dollars (plus two .50/.95 endings) with no scattered-cents pattern - passes the markup test, filed as the wall price. Many items carry itemPriceHasUpgrades:true, meaning the number is the starting price before a size/protein choice; flagged per-dish in description rather than silently treated as the full price.

name: Hot Tasty Pizza
notes: The /menu/ page (address-confirmed to 1826 Coronado Ave, San Diego 92154 via /location/, distinct from the chain's National City /menu-nc/ page) renders zero text/prices in HTML - the whole menu is 22 numbered photographed menu-board images, dated Feb 2024, found via /wp-json/wp/v2/pages listing then downloaded and read as JPEGs. All 22 items/deals read cleanly with no ambiguity except item 2 ("Triple Deal"), whose board shows one price (0.99) beside "3 LRG. PIZZAS...ea." and "must purchase 3 pizzas" - read as a per-pizza price, flagged in description rather than guessed as a bundle total. This is a deal-board menu (combo prices, not per-ingredient), which is genuinely how the restaurant prices - not a partial capture. "Garden" and "Antipasto" salads are mentioned on item 19's board as also available but carry no price of their own and were dropped rather than assumed to share the Greek Salad price.
